item.title: Drone attack on a police facility in Cúcuta injures three civilians, including an infant, and damages homes (Al Jazeera, AP)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Cúcuta, Norte de Santander, Colombia. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified armed group. Reported casualties: 3 injured. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. 4 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1912
